records.subject: Still want to get Clearwater Works set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Noticed Clearwater Works hasn't gotten a project going in Wrenfield yet. If something got in the way, happy to help clear it -- even a 10-minute call can usually unstick it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Clearwater Works
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Clearwater Works* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets or customer replies despite a welcome email [email:c141057a] and a held getting-started call [calendar:17f28d07]. Call attendance shows some intent, but zero product action afterwards suggests low momentum with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Picking up from our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. Since then I wanted to check in and see how things are going on your side.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the easiest place to begin.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through setting up your first project with you, or answer anything that came up afterwards.

Best,
Nadia
